source.release: Grid level prediction and uncertainty surfaces for selected reproductive, maternal, newborn, child, and adolescent health and development indicators for 2014 and 2022 Kenya, v1.0
source.method: Bayesian INLA-SPDE; 5x5km prediction surfaces. Original administrative aggregation is population weighted.

notes: Custom KDA polygon aggregation must use a population-weighted mean, matching the published method.
Grid-cell lower/upper credible surfaces may be aggregated only as diagnostics; they are not to be labelled as polygon-level credible intervals.
No constituency or ward value may publish from this probe alone.
